title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU中的图表征学习模块，该模块利用图摘要技术对原图快照进行压缩，并将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，通过重构误差训练原图节点的表征，从而高效处理大规模动态图的表征学习。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a graph representation learning module in GSAERU, a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which compresses the original graph snapshot using graph summarization technology, feeds the compressed graph into a graph autoencoder, and trains node representations via reconstruction error, efficiently handling representation learning on large-scale dynamic graphs.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
在单时间步上将图快照输入图表征学习模块
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器
利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
technical_features_en: Model the dynamic sequential graph as a sequence of snapshots at each time step
Input the graph snapshot into the graph representation learning module at a single time step
Compress the original graph through graph summarization technology
Feed the compressed graph into a graph autoencoder
Train the representations of original graph nodes using reconstruction error with the original graph

novelty_points.claim: 提出了GSAERU模型中的时序学习模块，该模块在获得单时间步图表征后，采用循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系，从而得到大规模时序图的高质量表征。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed the time sequence learning module in the GSAERU model, which, after obtaining graph representation at a single time step, uses a recurrent neural network to learn the feature information and dependencies of the original graph along the time dimension, thereby obtaining high-quality representations for large-scale sequential graphs.
technical_features: 将单时间步上获得的图表征输入时序学习模块
通过循环神经网络学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
输出大规模时序图的高质量表征
technical_features_en: Feed the graph representation obtained at a single time step into the time sequence learning module
Learn feature information and dependencies along the time dimension through a recurrent neural network
Produce high-quality representations for large-scale sequential graphs

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用“领导-工作者”模式，领导节点基于边分割的图流划分算法划分原图并分配子图给工作节点，工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回训练结果给领导节点，领导节点汇总结果计算梯度并同步更新所有计算节点上的模型，从而加速大规模图流数据的GNN训练。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode. The leader divides the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation, assigns subgraphs to workers; workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization, return training results to the leader through an attention layer; the leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes, thereby accelerating GNN training on large-scale graph streaming data.
technical_features: 采用“领导—工作者”工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
将划分的子图分配给各工作节点
工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，根据梯度同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: The leader divides the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation
Assign the divided subgraphs to each worker
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
The leader summarizes results, calculates gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes according to the gradient
